info.title: EXCLURAD request with invalid cos θ*=1.3

parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Eta at W = 1.7, Q2 = 1.0, cos theta* = 1.3, phi* = 90.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."

I’ll run EXCLURAD’s preflight for the requested eta point first. The requested `cos(theta*) = 1.3` is outside the physical range, so I’ll use the validator’s prescribed handling rather than silently generating an invalid input.

parts.text: The preflight check rejects the request because `cos(theta*) = 1.3` is outside the physical cosine range `[-1, 1]`. I will record the refusal without generating an EXCLURAD input file; clamping it would silently change the requested kinematics.
